method.caveat: Normal approximation on the reported bootstrap CI; treats the CI half-width as the sampling SE. Directional/scale evidence for design sizing, not a new confirmatory result.

summary.key_finding: Most historical windows were underpowered for the 2% materiality floor; only FCLR-009 (n=24495, 6 blocks) was adequately powered. The Track A liquidation recompute (n=593) needs ~11689 paired observations for a 2% MDE.
